thread:
anna_sales: FYI - AuroraHealth procurement wants an assurance pack for a 2-week POC. They asked for: redacted SOC2 AOC, ISO27001 excerpt, a signed pen-test attestation (their template attached), and a one-page network diagram. Also asked for Dedicated trial pricing. Deadline = 8 business days. Who can own the attestation?

diego_sec: We can provide redacted SOC2 AOC + ISO excerpt. If they want the full report we need an NDA and internal disclosure review. For the attestation: need explicit scope (hostnames/CIDRs) and whether Dedicated is in-scope.

harper_ops: If they run active scans we require source CIDRs, a scheduled scan window, and an emergency kill contact. Preferred flow is they upload findings to a presigned bucket. I can create the bucket once scope is final. Typical presign I share:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/aurorahealth/aurora-poc-evidence.zip --expires-in 604800
```

tom_pricing: Short Dedicated trial uplift estimate: +25% over hosted list for a 2-week reserved mini-pool (final depends on GPU SKU). I can produce a PO line-item once SKU is specified.

lina_legal: I can sign the pen-test attestation on company letterhead. Preconditions: (1) exact scope language (hostnames/CIDRs and whether Dedicated included), (2) PO or signed POC cover note referencing the engagement and billing entity. We'll provide an attestation only, not warranties/indemnities. Turnaround ~2 business days after receiving items.

anna_sales: Customer template lists scope: "staging.aurora.health" and requests "include dedicated pool if selected". They prefer uploads but security may still want to run a light scan. I'll ask procurement to pick uploads vs active scans and confirm whether they will issue a PO.

diego_sec: Suggested scope wording for legal: "Scope: testing limited to staging.aurora.health and associated staging infrastructure for AuroraHealth POC. Production systems and customer data are out-of-scope. Dedicated pool included only if explicitly purchased and referenced in the PO."

lina_legal: That scope is acceptable. If they insist on unredacted SOC2 we will require NDA + add ~5 business days for internal review. Otherwise redacted AOC + attestation is standard.

evidence-bot: evidence-system: Presigned evidence bucket standby created: s3://redwood-evidence/aurorahealth/ (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

harper_ops: Once @anna_sales confirms scan method I'll finalize runbook (allowed window, upload steps, validators, and ops contact). If they want peering we need 4-5 business days to schedule.

tom_pricing: I'll draft a Dedicated PO line-item with GPU options. @anna_sales let me know GPU class and whether they want the 2-week reserved window.

anna_sales: On it - pinging Aurora procurement/security now. Will update thread with PO or acceptance of uploads by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
